# `db/queries/user-credentials.ts`

## Overview

Provides async query functions for managing user credentials in the database. Each credential record associates a user with an external provider and a vault secret reference. Supported operations include lookup by user or user+provider pair, upsert creation, and deletion.

---

## Functions

### `getByUserAndProvider`

Returns the first credential record matching a given user and provider pair.

```ts
import { getByUserAndProvider } from 'db/queries/user-credentials';
```

#### Parameters

| Name       | Type     | Description                        |
|------------|----------|------------------------------------|
| `userId`   | `number` | The ID of the user.                |
| `provider` | `string` | The provider identifier to match.  |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  userId: number;
  provider: string;
  vaultSecretId: string;
  label: string | null;
}>
```

#### Example

```ts
const credential = await getByUserAndProvider(42, 'github');
console.log(credential.vaultSecretId);
```

---

### `getByUser`

Returns all credential records associated with a given user.

```ts
import { getByUser } from 'db/queries/user-credentials';
```

#### Parameters

| Name     | Type     | Description         |
|----------|----------|---------------------|
| `userId` | `number` | The ID of the user. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  userId: number;
  provider: string;
  vaultSecretId: string;
  label: string | null;
}[]>
```

#### Example

```ts
const credentials = await getByUser(42);
credentials.forEach(c => console.log(c.provider, c.label));
```

---

### `create`

Creates a new credential record. Performs an upsert keyed on the combination of `userId`, `provider`, and `label`.

```ts
import { create } from 'db/queries/user-credentials';
```

#### Parameters

| Name            | Type     | Required | Description                                           |
|-----------------|----------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| `userId`        | `number` | Yes      | The ID of the user.                                   |
| `provider`      | `string` | Yes      | The provider identifier (e.g. `'github'`).            |
| `vaultSecretId` | `string` | Yes      | The vault secret reference for this credential.       |
| `label`         | `string` | No       | An optional label to distinguish multiple credentials for the same user+provider. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  userId: number;
  provider: string;
  vaultSecretId: string;
  label: string | null;
}>
```

#### Example

```ts
// Without a label
const credential = await create(42, 'github', 'vault-secret-abc123');

// With a label
const labeled = await create(42, 'github', 'vault-secret-xyz789', 'work account');
```

---

### `deleteByUserAndProvider`

Deletes all credential records matching a given user and provider pair.

```ts
import { deleteByUserAndProvider } from 'db/queries/user-credentials';
```

#### Parameters

| Name       | Type     | Description                                       |
|------------|----------|---------------------------------------------------|
| `userId`   | `number` | The ID of the user.                               |
| `provider` | `string` | The provider identifier whose credentials to delete. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<void>
```

#### Example

```ts
await deleteByUserAndProvider(42, 'github');
```
